sketches.mechanism: SQL uses three-valued logic: any equality comparison involving NULL evaluates to UNKNOWN rather than TRUE or FALSE.
sketches.resonance: An absence cannot even confirm that it is identical to itself.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not retain its object, so an instance assigned only to a weak optional is deallocated immediately and the reference becomes nil.
sketches.resonance: What is held without possession disappears before it can be returned.
